action: No action needed; for awareness. The release gives no victim guidance; schools and healthcare bodies hit by INC or Lynx affiliates may wish to follow the case in the Eastern District of Tennessee.
actor: 8-Digits Team (linked to INC Ransom and Lynx)
exec: International cooperation delivered a suspect in attacks on US schools and healthcare; a sign of continuing enforcement pressure.
plain: A man from Kazakhstan was extradited from Italy to face US charges over ransomware attacks on schools and hospitals. Prosecutors say the group took 70 million health records and demanded over $500 million.

key_findings: Roman Khlynovskiy, 43, a Kazakh national, was extradited from Italy and made his first appearance in the Eastern District of Tennessee.
The 8-Digits Team, affiliated with INC and Lynx ransomware, allegedly hit schools and hospitals in at least six states.
Over 50 terabytes were taken, including more than 70 million confidential health records; ransom demands exceeded $500 million.
Charges include computer fraud and identity theft conspiracy, wire fraud conspiracy, computer extortion, money laundering conspiracy and threats under the TAKE IT DOWN Act.
Italian, Ukrainian and Lithuanian authorities assisted; the maximum penalty is 27 years.
recommendations: The release contains no guidance for victims or defenders.

summary: Roman Khlynovskiy, 43, a Kazakh national, was extradited from Italy and appeared in federal court in Knoxville, Tennessee. Prosecutors allege the 8-Digits Team, affiliated with INC and Lynx ransomware, hit schools and hospitals in at least six states, took over 50 terabytes including more than 70 million confidential health records, and demanded over $500 million. He faces up to 27 years.
